resources.string: This watchface file has no Watch Face Push token for this AAPS app, and the watch cannot install the watchface without one. Make the watchface again with a token.
This file is not a watchface.
The watch has not told its Wear OS version yet. Check the connection, and that the AAPS app on the watch is of the same version.

string.name: wear_wff_face_watch_too_old
string.comment: %1$s = a Wear OS version, for example 5 or 6

resources.string: This watchface needs Wear OS %1$s or newer on the watch.
This watchface was made for another AAPS app. Make it again for this app.
Watchface sent. Confirm the install on the watch, then pick the watchface on the watch.
The watchface could not be sent to the watch. Check the connection and try again.

string.name: wear_design_type_wff
string.comment: One line of an entry in the list of watchface files. WFF is the short name of the Watch Face Format of Wear OS: keep it as it is.

string.name: wear_design_type_cwf
string.comment: One line of an entry in the list of watchface files. CWF is the short name of a design for the AAPS Custom watchface: keep it as it is.

string.name: wear_wff_face_on_watch
string.comment: %1$s = name of a watchface loaded from a file
